terms.gloss: observed / actual result, literally the result found
terms.comment: Our description, “the result found”, set against exitus exspectātus, the expected result. Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no term for the actual result of a test.
The earlier alternative; a modern formation.

phrases.english: The actual result differs from the expected result.

sources: Lewis & Short: exitus. Dictionary links support the component words; the modern technical expressions are labelled separately.
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
